offering_description.value: Sells life science research tools and clinical diagnostic products to laboratories, hospitals and pharmaceutical developers. It makes instruments, reagents and antibodies in-house and sells them directly and through distributors.

primary_products.value: research reagents and antibodies; PCR and digital PCR systems; chromatography and electrophoresis instruments; clinical immunoassay systems; diagnostic quality controls

primary_services.value: custom antibody and reagent development; quality-control program services

customer_segment.value: B2B: academic and industrial research labs, hospitals, clinical diagnostic labs, pharmaceutical and biotech companies; B2G: government research institutes and public health laboratories

end_markets.value: life science research; clinical diagnostics; pharmaceutical development; food safety testing

revenue_model.value: product sales: instruments, reagents, antibodies and diagnostic test kits sold to labs and hospitals; service fees: instrument service contracts, training and custom development work; licensing or royalties: patent licenses for digital PCR and related technologies
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes instruments, reagents and diagnostic kits, sold to labs and hospitals; brand owner: designs and sells research and clinical brands, some made with contract partners, to end users

geography_served.value: global: sells in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: life science research products and clinical diagnostics, sharing lab customers and instrument platforms

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to large research and hospital accounts; distributors / dealers: independent distributors in many countries and regions; online: online catalog and ordering for research reagents

regulatory_exposure.value: high: clinical diagnostic products need FDA clearance or approval and comply with CLIA and IVD device rules
